scene.status: G10B preflight candidate; implementation blocked by G10A

controls.label: Ring count
controls.serializedMeaning: Chooses automatic count or exactly two/three orbital memberships, clamped by available satellites.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed media, primary, canvas, and story time, satellite ringIndex/slotIndex assignments and signed revolution tables change deterministically while source order and primary identity stay fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Ring topology is intrinsic Scene structure, not Timeline pace or Look treatment.

controls.label: Orbit size
controls.serializedMeaning: Scales all projected ring radii before canvas-specific recomposition.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed time, satellite x/y distances from centre change while membership, source size, primary pose, depth phase, and revolution count remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Radial apparatus size defines composition and collision pressure.

controls.label: Vertical squash
controls.serializedMeaning: Sets the projected vertical compression of every orbital plane.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed time, satellite y positions change while x radius, membership, source dimensions, and primary pose remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Plane projection is Scene geometry and determines whether nested rings remain legible.

controls.label: Satellite scale
controls.serializedMeaning: Sets natural-ratio satellite height before ring/depth hierarchy and portrait wide-card reduction.
controls.causalObservation: Satellite width/height change proportionally while primary size, ring poses, membership, and source order remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Satellite-to-primary hierarchy is an intrinsic Scene capability.

controls.label: Orbit pace
controls.serializedMeaning: Scales the canonical 12-second reconciled master-cycle duration during Timeline compilation without changing integer revolution counts.
controls.causalObservation: Compiled duration changes from 20 seconds at 0.6 to 8.571429 seconds at 1.4; normalized pose and exact seam remain identical.
controls.ownershipReason: The apparatus needs a bounded cadence capability; authoritative story duration and segments remain Timeline-owned.

serializedIntentNotControls.reason: Primary identity is a semantic media role, not untracked local UI state.
Role exchange must be reproducible in preview, scrub, and export.
Direction is already portable Timeline truth and must not be duplicated.

rejectedControls.reason: Would permit non-reconciling or quasi-periodic drift.
Destroys exact repeat and stable hierarchy.
Diagnostic/accessory state, not essential Scene capability.
Look treatment cannot touch artwork or carry identity.
Primary authority must be serialized intent.
